vars.label: Jobs within 30 minutes by car (estimate)
vars.ref: Estimated by the observatory: QCEW jobs by municipio spread over Overture business places, reached by car over the OpenStreetMap road graph (roads.bin) at planning speeds from each 2020 Census block with residents (jobs_reach.py)
vars.definition: The average number of jobs that the municipio's residents can reach within 30 minutes by car. An estimate: QCEW's 2025 jobs of each municipio, spread over its business places (Overture), reached over the mapped roads at free-flow planning speeds with a car, from where residents live (2020 Census blocks, each weighted by its residents). No traffic, parking or transit is assumed. QCEW counts jobs where they are, not who holds them, and leaves out the self-employed.
